capabilities: Store account credentials with encrypted local storage
Search entries by title, username, link, note, or group
Back up and restore the vault as a JSON snapshot
Import and export data in Markdown or JSON formats
extras: The README explicitly cautions that it is a lightweight recording tool rather than a replacement for dedicated password managers, and warns Git users to exclude encryption key files or accept that ciphertext will be committed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store and organize account credentials and passwords alongside notes.
summary: Local password manager that stores encrypted account credentials in groups inside the vault with search, backup, and import/export.
